newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, mild gains for blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, mild gains for blue chips.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mixed on Thursday, with mild new gains in fully listed issues, and some further losses among hoteliers.
* Of nine active stocks, five rose and four fell.
* Volume lower at 8,811 shares, turnover also down at 7.7 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer was drugs firm Pliva which added 99 kuna to close at 12,900, on volume of 125 shares.
* Biggest loser was hotelier Istraturist, down 11 kuna, with 200 shares sold.
* The most actively traded was Zagrebacka Banka which inched up five kuna, selling 2,726 units.
